tool.name: evaluate_qtdb.py
tool.gate_role: Guard QT/QRS/T measurements and boundary behaviour on a non-LUDB database (doc 05 B: Phases 1 and 3).
tool.cadence: Every release; optional on PRs touching delineation/intervals (doc 06).

datasets.name: QTDB
datasets.release: PhysioNet qtdb (version not stated in the local copy; identity = manifest hash)
datasets.subset_rule: All 105 records in RECORDS that have a .q1c annotation (the tool's own discovery rule), passed explicitly via --records.

extraction_config.sparse_adapter: channels in slots II/V2, rest zero; scored slot II

record_schema_note: legacy ecgfeat export (pre-ECG-Record); no record schema is exercised by these tools at this revision

determinism.ungated_note: runtime/wall-clock values; environment-dependent, not gated, not a result difference
